title: GOD'S FOREKNOWLEDGE - HIS ETERNAL REALM

blocks.text: “This correspondence should be interesting and very enlightening how God works in His eternal realm! The Scriptures say, He is the same yesterday, today and forever! He is the Lord, He changes not and inhabits eternity as well as all of His creations!” – “Now how much did God know about us before we came? Did he foreknow all of His people before birth? It is a deep subject, but the Bible reveals the truth, and we will take it line upon line!”

“Did God talk to Jeremiah before he came? There is proof that He did, but Jeremiah may not have remembered it!” … The evidence, Jer. 1:5, “The Lord God said, before I formed thee in the belly, ‘I knew thee!’ – He ordained him as a prophet to the nations! God formed Adam as a whole man; the next thing that followed was a tiny seed. And yet He foreknew what Adam would look like!” – “David said in Ps. 139:15-16 that when the Lord created him He saw his substance before hand, wrote his different parts in a book, and then fashioned him when as yet he had not been born! – Verse 6 says, God’s knowledge is too high for him, he cannot attain unto it! … David was revealing something about all of us; God’s foreknowledge of each individual that will go and come upon the earth! … In other words, David said before he ever came into his mother’s womb God knew what he would look like!” (Read verses 13-14) – “The Lord also gave David the name of his son Solomon long before he was born. And that he would build the house of the Lord and bring rest, prosperity and peace to Israel!” (I Chr. 22:9) – “Also did you ever think about this? If God can talk to a person after he is dead (at the White Throne and etc.) and He can!…then by His supreme power He can see or talk to someone before they are born! … like a prophet or King and give certain instructions that they do not know at the time, but may dawn upon them later after birth that, that was the way it was given! – Remember we have a spiritual personality that comes with our body; and that spiritual personality will go back to God, and we will have a glorified body!”

Here is a Scripture that many believe concerns God’s elect! Job 38:4, “when God asked Job where was he at when He laid the foundations of the earth…And then revealed verse 7 to him! When the Morning Stars sang together, and all the sons of God shouted for joy!” – Isa. 46:10, “reveals God declares the end from the beginning, the things that are not yet done, saying My counsel shall stand!” – “Then it is possible for God to give certain information to an individual before they are born through a seed. Because in continuance He even gives more information while men sleep!” Job 33:14-17 – Verse 16, “Then he openeth the ears of men, and sealeth their instructions while they sleep! Verse 14, God speaketh it, yet man perceiveth it not at the time!”

The deep things of God are a mystery, but are revealed unto His elect! … “Behold saith the living God, without faith and knowledge of My Word he cannot attain unto such wonders! Have ye not heard that only Mine elect and those who have died in the faith shall hear My voice and meet Me in the air and the others upon the earth shall not! – It is because I foreknow you, and ye shall hear My voice!”

“Here is another individual and God foretold his name in the Scriptures beforehand! It is this King that would be the one to let Israel go home after their captivity in Babylon!” … Isa. 44:28, “His name is King Cyrus – Isa. 45:1-3 – The Lord said He would perform all His pleasure, because the Lord foreknew who He would send!” – “There are many other instances in the Scriptures, but this reveals God’s foreknowledge and plans for the ages!”

“Jesus foreknew the names of all of His disciples and knew all about their characters! – It was all foreknown from the beginning!” – Rev. 13:8, “reveals His elect people’s names are written in the Book of Life, and that pre-knowledge of Jesus slain before the foundation of the world is given!” – “He was the Word, St. John 1:1, 10, 14 – Rev. 1:8 – These verses foretell us that He knows all things ahead of time! – John and Daniel both saw people around the Throne thousands of years in advance, even before this large group was born, they saw them standing there in a vision!” (Dan. 7:9-10 – Rev. 5:11-14) – “Here is some real evidence of our destiny, providence and the predestination of the Lord! – Eph. 1:4-5, wherein the master prophet and apostle Paul says, ‘He has chosen us in Him before the foundation of the world. He has predestined us according to His good pleasure and will.’ And ‘that we should be holy and without blame before Him in love!’ – Verse 11 says, being predestined according to the purpose of him who worketh all things after the counsel of His own will!’ – Verse 9 says, He hath made known to us the mystery of His will!”

“You might wonder how much does God know about us or His people? – He already knows all things! – We are to live by faith and do the best that we can for Him” – It is our hour to shine for Him and to win many souls in the harvest field! – Our deeds of love and work for Him are written in His book of deeds! One thing that we do know is that all of God’s books including the Book of Life was written before the foundation of the world!” (Rev. 20:12) – “As we know Daniel told of these same things thousands of years in advance!”

“I believe the real elect of God will understand these subjects and that they will know the manifold wisdom of the Lord Jesus! – And that their hearts will receive salvation, the spirit and the Word of God will abide with them because of their earnest faith and trust in Him! … The real people of God will not be disappointed in what He has reserved for them! And even in our time He has some amazing and wonderful things for them in the near future! – Praise Him!” – “There are scores of other Scriptures that can add more weight to all this written, but it is enough to show His divine providence and foreknowledge!”
